```yaml
name: Run Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck

      - name: Run test suite
        run: |
          chmod +x ./tests/run-tests.sh
          ./tests/run-tests.sh
```
